scenarios.prompt: Activate a timed event for an eligible cohort, retry reward delivery, then expire it. Event ID/config revision and reward transaction remain stable and idempotent.

criteria.versioning: Event ID/config revision and client/schema compatibility are explicit.
criteria.transactions: Eligibility/cohort and reward transaction handling are deterministic/idempotent.
criteria.fallback: Expiry, missing config and incompatible clients have a declared usable fallback.
